newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Oct 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Oct 18.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not gaurantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.

- The South Korean Defense Minister has been replaced. General Kim Dong-jin, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, replaced Minister Lee Yang-ho. General Yoon Yong-Nam, Army Chief of Staff, was appointed as the new Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of staff.
- U.S. CIA director John Deutch arrived in Seoul on Thursday at the invitation of South Korea's top intelligence officials. He is expected to meet with President Kim Young-sam.
- Former Defense Minister Lee Yang-ho has been accused by the opposition National Congress for New Politics of leaking military secrets while he was Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.

- President Kim Young-sam replaced Defense Minister Lee Yang-ho with General Kim Dong-jin, chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. Kim made the appointment out of apparrent displeasure with the military's failure to detect a North Korean submarine which sneaked into South Korean waters on September 18.
- Kim Dong-jin was named Defense minister, replacing Lee Yang-ho in an apparant reprimand in connextion with the recent North Korean submarine intrusion.
